# Liverpool Emergency Plumber

> 24/7 emergency plumber and gas engineer for Liverpool and Merseyside. Call 0151 558 0334, answered 24 hours a day. An engineer is typically with you within 30 minutes. No call-out fee: from £120 for the first hour. A team of Gas Safe registered engineers led by James. Rated 5.0 from 53 Google reviews.

## Key facts

- Business: Liverpool Emergency Plumber, 29 Park Road, Kirkby, Merseyside L32 2AL
- Phone: 0151 558 0334, answered 24/7 including weekends and bank holidays
- Arrival: typically within 30 minutes of your call across Liverpool
- Call-out fee: none. You pay a fixed price for the first hour of the engineer's time, which includes finding the fault. Most jobs are fixed within that hour
- First hour: £120 on weekdays 9am to 4pm; £150 on weekday evenings, nights (4pm to 9am) and weekends; £180 on bank holidays
- Extra time or parts: priced before the engineer carries on
- Boiler repair: the same prices, with diagnosis included in the first hour
- Engineers: Gas Safe registered; all engineers G3 unvented qualified
- Workmanship guarantee: 12 months. Public liability insurance: £2m
- Areas: every Liverpool postcode, plus the Wirral, Sefton (Bootle, Crosby, Formby, Maghull, Southport), Knowsley (Huyton, Kirkby) and St Helens
- Website: https://liverpoolemergencyplumber.co.uk/

## Emergencies we handle, 24/7

- [Leaks and burst pipes](https://liverpoolemergencyplumber.co.uk/leak-detection-liverpool): water pouring or dripping, pipes split by frost, leaks under sinks and taps
- [Water coming through the ceiling](https://liverpoolemergencyplumber.co.uk/leak-detection-liverpool): drips or a wet patch from the floor above; we find and fix the leak
- [Boiler broken, no heating](https://liverpoolemergencyplumber.co.uk/boiler-repair-liverpool): error codes, low pressure, boiler locked out
- [No hot water](https://liverpoolemergencyplumber.co.uk/boiler-repair-liverpool): combi, system and regular boilers, and hot water cylinders
- [Gas leaks and gas appliance faults](https://liverpoolemergencyplumber.co.uk/emergency-gas-engineer-liverpool): repairs once the gas supply has been made safe
- [Leaking radiators](https://liverpoolemergencyplumber.co.uk/radiators-liverpool): leaking valves, pipes and radiators
- Frozen pipes

## What to do while you wait

- **Water leak or burst pipe:** turn off the water at the stopcock. It is usually under the kitchen sink, in a hallway cupboard or under the stairs. Turn it clockwise. Turn off any electrics near the water if safe. Open the cold taps to drain the pipes. Then call 0151 558 0334.
- **Smell gas:** leave the property. Do not use light switches or flames. Turn off the gas at the meter if it is safe, and call the National Gas Emergency number on 0800 111 999. Once the leak is made safe, call us on 0151 558 0334 to repair the appliance or pipework.
- **Carbon monoxide alarm sounding:** turn off gas appliances and open doors and windows if it is safe, get everyone outside into fresh air, then call the National Gas Emergency number on 0800 111 999. If anyone feels unwell, call 999.

## New boiler packages (fixed price, fully fitted, including VAT)

Combi boiler swap, Liverpool and Merseyside. Every package includes a smart thermostat, magnetic filter, system clean, carbon monoxide alarm, Gas Safe certificate, manufacturer registration and removal of the old boiler. Free survey and written fixed price before work starts. Full details: https://liverpoolemergencyplumber.co.uk/boiler-installation-liverpool

- Essential, Baxi 600 Combi 2 (24 or 30kW): £2,195. 7-year manufacturer warranty. Best for flats, small terraces and rental homes
- Value, Baxi 800 Combi 2 (24 or 30kW): £2,495. 10-year warranty, magnetic filter in the box. Best for 2 to 3 bed homes if you are staying put
- Most popular, Worcester Bosch Greenstar 4000 (25 or 30kW): £2,695. Up to 10-year warranty. Best for most 2 to 4 bed homes
- Premium, Vaillant ecoTEC plus (826 or 832): £2,995. Up to 10-year warranty. Best for busier homes and two bathrooms
- Flagship, Worcester Bosch Greenstar 8000+ Style (32kW): £3,295. Up to 12-year warranty. Best for larger homes or a boiler on show in the kitchen
- Next size up: +£200. Ideal Logic Max available on request: £2,695
- Extras: move the boiler in the same room £450, to another room £750, to another floor £850; swap a tank system for a combi +£695
- System and regular boilers: priced after a free survey

## Fixed prices (all include VAT)

- Gas safety certificate (landlord CP12): £100 for up to two gas appliances, usually the boiler and hob, £20 per extra appliance after two. Landlords with 3 or more properties: £80 per property. Covers boilers, gas cookers and hobs (not gas fires). Certificate emailed the same day
- Boiler service: £120. Gas safety certificate + boiler service in one visit: £199. Unvented cylinder service: £120
- Power flush: up to 6 radiators £395; 7 to 10 radiators £525; 11 to 15 radiators £675; extra radiators £40 each. Chemical system clean £195. Magnetic filter £195 fitted (£150 with a flush)
- Radiators: new radiator supplied and fitted from £245; five radiators supplied and fitted from £1,195; fit your own radiator from £95; move a radiator from £225; TRVs £65 each or 6 for £295
- Central heating (new system, final price after a free survey): 2-bed from £4,495; 3-bed from £5,295; 4-bed from £6,295; tank system to combi conversion from £2,890
- Showers: electric shower supplied and fitted from £375; bar mixer shower from £395; concealed thermostatic shower from £695; power shower from £650; fit your own shower from £195
- Bathrooms: cloakroom from £2,495; en-suite from £4,495; full bathroom supplied and fitted from £4,995; bath to shower conversion from £2,395
- Hot water cylinders: vented replacement from £750; unvented 150L from £1,450, 210L from £1,695, 250 to 300L from £1,995; vented to unvented conversion from £1,895; immersion heater £175 (vented) or £275 (unvented). All engineers are G3 qualified
